messages:
Cara S.: Quick handoff for AtlasHealth (enterprise, HIPAA). Contract signed 2024-03-28. Customer expects private deploy (us-east-1) on dedicated capacity; asked for 2x GPU baseline. SSO via Okta + SCIM. Legal still finalizing DPA and export controls (est ~2w). They gave us a sanitized dataset for early tests. Trial 30d; onboarding week target 2024-04-12. Renewal risk flagged if we miss trial window. CS owns kickoff, Support/Eng own infra + private deploy. @Mike C. can you lead kickoff? @Jen S. handle support checklist? @Alex G. engineering lead on deploy.

Mike C.: Yep — I'll open CS-5912 and schedule kickoff. Need Okta dev admin + SCIM test tenant credentials, plus sample prompt set and expected QPS. Planning a short demo run thru before enablement. Tentative kickoff: 2024-03-29 09:30 ET.

Cara S.: Shared Okta dev link and 1Password: 1p://vault/teams/atlas (shared with Mike/Jen/Alex). Contract link: drive.redwood/Atlas_DPA. Sales note: customer will provide 10 "critical flows" they want validated.

Jen S.: Support checklist draft: VPN/peering, cert issuance, KMS access, monitoring hooks, SIEM forwarding, runbook for failover. Do they require HSM? Cara: "prefer HSM but not mandatory" 1. I'll mark HSM as dependency on Legal. Also need network CIDR from customer; ask for static egress IPs for allowlisting.

Alex G.: For the private deploy we'll template a 2-GPU cluster and include fallback to hosted variant if capacity constrained. To size kernels we need: typical sequence length, p99 tokens, and concurrent sessions. If p95 latency target is 200ms, we might need quantization profile. @Mike please add workload numbers to CS-5912.

Priya R.: Enablement plan: two sessions 1 admin/setup and prompt engineering plus evaluation. I'll prepare a mini-eval harness that runs the 10 critical flows and records latency + relevance. Ask CS/support to agree on acceptance criteria (example: p95 latency <250ms; human relevance >=0.7 on first-pass).

Mike C.: Added workload & dataset to CS-5912: demo QPS 8-15, typical seq 300 tokens, spikes up to 1200 tokens for batch jobs. Sanitized dataset link included and Atlas POC contact (tara@atlashealth). Also noted trial token commitment ceiling provided by Sales.

Cara S.: LegalBot will track DPA signature. I'll keep nudging. Also customer requested a short SOP for data deletion at end of trial 1 we'll add to runbook.

LegalBot: DPA status: draft sent 2024-03-28. Legal review ETA 14 days. HSM requirement currently "optional" pending contract clause.

Jen S.: Action items I own: open peering request, request certs, create KMS provisioning ticket, add SIEM hook doc. I'll set internal escalation if Legal >14 days.

Alex G.: Engineering actions: create infra PR for private template, add quantization options, test fallback routing to hosted model variants, and produce deploy runbook. Due 2024-04-05.

Mike C.: Owners summary + due dates:
- CS kickoff & runbook (Mike C.) 1 due 2024-03-29
- Enablement & eval harness (Priya R.) 1 due 2024-04-09
- Infra template + deploy runbook (Alex G.) 1 due 2024-04-05
- Support infra (Jen S.) 1 due 2024-04-03
- Legal/DPA (Sales/Legal) 1 tracking by Cara
I'll post weekly updates here. Please ping for blockers. :shipit:

Cara S.: Thanks everyone. If legal or customer stalls, escalate to me.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: 2024-03-29 09:30 ET. Link: meet.redwood/atlaskickoff.
